full_judgment:
16. The second ground of Mr. Chowdhury is that there was inordinate delay in lodging the first information report. The alleged incident took place in the evening of 28.2.85 and the FIR was lodged on the next day on 1.3.85 at 7-00 AM although according to PW 1 Sadir Mia Police Station was 200 to 300 cubits away towards south from their house. Ordinarily when a first information report is lodged soon after the occurrence leaving no scope for consultation and fabrication, the presumption is that it is a truthful account eliminating the possibility of substitution or false implication. On the other hand, the Courts have always viewed first information report with grave suspicion when there has been unexplained delay in giving it and under this situation it can be presumed that the delay in the registration of FIR was used for the purpose of manipulation of the prosecution story. In the instant case neither in the FIR nor in the deposition of the informant PW 1 Sadir Mia there is any explanation for lodging the first information report after twelve hours, more so when the Police Station is only 200 10 300 cubits away from the house of the informant It appears from the impugned judgment that the learned Sessions Judge had made out a third case to explain away this delay in lodging the FIR based on his own presumption. This is illegal and thus the learned Sessions Judge misdirected himself in arriving at a faulty decision. 

 17. The third ground of Mr. Chowdhury is that although the prosecution case is that the witnesses recognised the accused persons by the focus of the torch light carried by PW 3 Shamsul Islam, but the torch light was not seized by the Investigating Officer even when PW 3 Shamsul Islam stated that he showed the torch light to the Investigating Officer even when PW 3 Shamsul Islam stated that he showed the torch light to the Investigating Officer. It appears from the impugned judgment that the learned Sessions Judge blamed the Police for not seizing the torch light on the presumption that PW 3 Shamsul Islam in fact went to the place of occurrence with a torch light. This approach is also erroneous. The true approach would have been that if PW Shamsul Islam had a torch light with him, the torch light must have been seized by the Investigating Officer if it was produced by the PW 3.
